policies.typing: Compatible contiguous typing uses explicit logical token plus engine-checked context, direction, marks and generation; no clock. Nonempty replacements remain isolated.
policies.barriers: Navigation to a changed typed Selection, state-only marks and explicit boundary break coalescing but preserve redo. Identical Selection equality (endpoint variant, direction and affinity included) is a true no-op; logical position equivalence alone does not grant equality.
policies.state_only: Collapsed toggles are not document units. Undo/redo restore actual before/after selection and marks of document unit; marks None vs Some(empty) remain distinct.
policies.branch: Only successful NEW document publication clears redo; refused/noop/query preserve it and all committed facets.
policies.isolation: IME semantic commit, paste, drop, toolbar/structural/slash compound are isolated; mounted event ownership remains later host gates.
policies.typography: Explicit trigger+replacement compound is one unit. Input-rule matching remains48.
policies.retention: Accepted ceilings:64 chronological transitions,64 combined action units,32 members/unit,4096 recipe steps/unit,16MiB payload/unit,32MiB aggregate unique history/map payload+metadata. Host only tightens. Member/step/unit payload crossing seals old group and starts a new supported unit if that new unit fits; oversize isolated action refuses. Protect new transition/unit; evict oldest maps, then oldest whole undo units, then furthest redo while preserving immediate chain. No partial member eviction.
policies.remount: Existing35 success creates new generation/IDs, revision0,selectionNone,marksinherit,dirtyfalse,empty maps/history; invalid remount preserves old generation. No undo-to-saved dirty reset.
policies.replacement: Selected/nonempty replacement edits form separate isolated units, even with the same typing token. No mixed net-cancel optimizer is required; earlier revisions/maps remain.
policies.history_profile: HistoryProfile:TransactionProfile; blanket CP delegates final typing/error hooks; explicitly implemented TP-only profile has no fake command catalog. Restored finalizer output must EXACTLY equal saved marks; even successful mark rewrite refuses.
policies.history_request_guard: Checked HistoryEpoch H is separate from doc revision/context epoch. Supplied stale H refuses with other tokens fresh; omitted optional bootstrap H grants no cached authority. One successful history/grouping/retention mutation increments H once; noop/refusal/alreadysealed boundary preserve H. Remount resets H only with new generation.
